title: Warehouse fulfillment with limited packing stations
description: Order owners choose whether to pick, expedite, or cancel their assigned order. Picking and packing each require shared equipment. There is stock for fewer orders than requested. One tick represents two minutes. Order owners make decisions; the runtime enforces stock conditions and equipment capacity.
guidelines: Complete orders when stock is available.
Urgent orders should prefer faster shipping when its cost is justified.
Cancel an unfilled order when waiting is no longer acceptable.
assumptions: Synthetic operating assumptions; demand and behavior have not been measured.
A picking cart reserves capacity, while stock is consumed only when picking completes.
No replenishment occurs during this run; each owner controls one order.

roles.name: Standard order owner
roles.goal: Ship the order cheaply; tolerate a reasonable wait.

roles.name: Urgent order owner
roles.goal: Meet today's deadline, even if expedited shipping costs more.
